mk.answer: In {month}, {name} saw {trips} trips per day with {type} and {fleet} vehicles in the feed – {tvd} trips per vehicle per day.
mk.answerNoCity: There is no index value for {name} in {month} (fewer than 10 vehicles or no full days measured).
mk.answerNone: The Germany index starts with the first fully measured day in the monthly archive; every collector run updates it.
mk.kNoPrev: no value for the previous month
mk.how: Mean over the fully measured days of the month (at least 20 measured hours per operator), all operators of a city and vehicle type together. Trips are counted trip starts; estimated for operators with rotating IDs. Values per operator appear only after checking the licence of every source. The previous month's index is created on the 1st in the first collector run.
mk.indexSub: Cities with at least 10 vehicles, sorted by trips per day; chart per city and vehicle type to download.
mk.indexNote: Covered are operators with an open GBFS feed; cities without such feeds are missing. The monthly files are in the data branch under index/.
mk.noIndex: No index yet – it starts with the first fully measured day of the month (after the next collector run).
mk.chartDe: Trips per day in the largest cities
mk.weekSub: Created automatically on Mondays from the completed calendar week; the topic changes weekly.
mk.noWeek: The first chart is created once a calendar week has at least 5 fully measured days – checked with the next collector run.
mk.openSub: One package per month with daily and monthly values per municipality and vehicle type (CSV) and a data description (datapackage.json, README).
mk.noOpen: The first package is created in the first collector run from the 1st of next month for the completed month.
mk.evSub: Actual against the forecast issued the day before within the event's time window, with a 90 % band from the other days of the same city. {n} estimates. {mine}
mk.evNoneHere: None yet for {name} – all cities shown.
mk.noEvents: No estimate yet – it is created after an event day ends, once five comparison days with a forecast exist (checked with the next collector run).
mk.prSub: Difference in differences: the operator's trips against the other operators of the same city and type, 7 full days before and after the change each, 95 % interval.
mk.noPrices: No price change in the log (pricing-log.json) – checked with every collector run (about every 18 minutes).
mk.scSub: {n} municipalities with at least {pop} inhabitants and no sharing in the open feeds, ranked by inhabitants, density, distance to the nearest sharing municipality and the sharing fleet within {km} km.
mk.noScout: The scout runs once a day with the next collector run.
mk.rFleet: {n} sharing vehicles in {c} municipality(ies) within {km} km
